summary: More workflow rules: recursive workflows stop on error, sub-workflow artifacts pass downstream, job templates with ask_inventory_on_launch=true use the workflow inventory while others keep their own, and set_stats data merges unpredictably on convergence so keys must be unique.
questions: Why does my job template ignore the workflow inventory?
How do I make a workflow inventory apply to job templates?
Are artifacts passed from nested workflows?
Why are set_stats values overwritten in a convergent workflow?

answer_card.title: Workflow inventory and job templates
answer_card.answer_md: A workflow can set an inventory or prompt for one. At launch, job templates in it with `ask_inventory_on_launch=true` (*Prompt on launch* for Inventory) use the workflow's inventory; job templates that don't prompt ignore it and run against their own inventory. Schedules and parent workflow nodes can supply the inventory when the workflow prompts for it.
